description: Aider-polyglot style (Python): implement the next fire times of a five-field cron expression from a stub and an instructions file - ranges, steps (including the single-value shorthand), lists, month and weekday names, Sunday as 0 or 7, the either-matches rule when both day fields are restricted (with the star-prefix definition of restricted), months without day 31, leap days and strictly-after semantics. The unit tests are the acceptance bar and the post-turn verifier gives a repair round with the test output, like aider's second try.
